status_note: The 16-record CPoolRecord/ConstantPoolInternal behavior projection byte-matches locked Ghidra 12.0.4, including canonical type identity, all tags, reference projection/order, misses, duplicate/clear-recreate, and two exception partial-state paths. Overall remains MISMATCH because Datatype::encode_ref still emits private dynamic packed IDs, constructor/destructor decode cannot call TypeFactory::decodeTypeWithCodeFlags, and byte-data >=0x80 cannot be represented as Ghidra's raw one-byte string through the current UTF-8 Encoder API.
architecture: x86:LE:64:default:gcc; locked BfdArchitecture over examples/curl; byte-addressed 64-bit little-endian spaces

compiler_spec.usage: The C++ fixture initializes the production BfdArchitecture and asserts its full archid. Cpool operations then use the architecture TypeFactory's canonical int4 and bool types; no function analysis option is changed.

analysis_options.fixture_model: The C++ side decodes production XML with XmlDecode. The Rust side builds the identical ordered element/attribute graph with TreeEncoder/TreeDecoder because TreeDecoder does not expose parsed character content as Ghidra's synthetic ATTRIB_CONTENT. Both sides resolve int4 and bool through their production TypeFactory and compare factory-owned pointer/Arc identity.
analysis_options.normalization: None inside the 16 covered records: stdout lines, ordering, values, names, exception text, and identity booleans are byte-compared. The complete raw packed and codeflags lines are excluded as whole registered residual records and are required to remain unequal.

input_manifest.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON array, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false
cases: production factory: Ghidra BfdArchitecture and Rust TypeFactory resolve canonical int4(size=4,TYPE_INT) and bool(size=1,TYPE_BOOL); observations compare raw pointer identity vs Arc::ptr_eq

typed tags: nine records supplied out of map order cover primitive, string_literal, class_reference, pointer_method, pointer_field, array_length, instance_of, check_cast, and unknown-tag fallback; primitive value=287454020; string bytes=0x00..0x10
reference projection: [4] aliases [4,0], [4,0,77] aliases [4,0], [0,4] and [100,1] miss; encode walks lexicographic CheapSorter(a,b) order

duplicate/replacement: putRecord [42,7] field/original/int4; duplicate check_cast/replacement/bool throws exact token-bearing error and preserves old record; clear then recreate installs replacement/bool
missing-data partial state: valid [1,1] prefix; [13,6] string with token instead of data throws after insertion/tag/token and before type; [20,1] is not visited
type-resolution partial state: [14,6] field token typed-before-error with missing_cpool_type typeref throws after insertion/tag/token and leaves null type

packed wire: complete ConstantPoolInternal::encode bytes include every ref/record/value/token/data/type reference without normalization; Cpool-owned prefix matches and Datatype private dynamic IDs remain an explicit residual

codeflags: [30,1] method has constructor+destructor and pointer-to-code with prototype; locked decodeTypeWithCodeFlags errors with null type while Rugra generic canonical decode succeeds without a prototype

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: MATCH for canonical type object identity, type-name display, tag/flags/token/value/data, duplicate return/error, all queried records, and exception-time partial map state. Code TypeFactory flags remain MISMATCH under TYPEFACTORY-CODEFLAGS-DECODE-0001.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_and_order: MATCH for byte-data loop 0..length, wrap reset after each 16th byte, decode child sequence, and BTreeMap/C++ map begin-to-end lexicographic iteration. >=0x80 raw-byte encoding remains UNTESTED under MARSHAL-PACKED-0001.
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: MATCH for byte wrap initialization/increment/reset, byte count, primitive value initialization, and one record allocation per decoded ref. No hidden counter is normalized.
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: MATCH: CheapSorter compares a first, then b; one-component refs supply b=0 and all components after index 1 are ignored. Packed type-ID comparison remains MISMATCH under MARSHAL-ID-0001.

typed_tags_and_order.covers: all eight tags, unknown-tag primitive fallback, primitive value, token/data selection, 17-byte data including wrap boundary, canonical int4/bool identity, instance_of storage, lexicographic encode order

lookup_projection.covers: miss, reversed miss, one-component alias, ignored third reference component

duplicate_and_replacement.covers: exact duplicate exception, old-record preservation, clear and same-key recreation with new canonical type

missing_data_partial_state.covers: exact error, valid prefix retention, bad-record tag/token/null-type retention, later record not visited

type_resolution_partial_state.covers: exact unresolved-type error and insertion/tag/token/null-type partial state

packed_wire.covers: complete raw PackedEncode record retained on both sides

constructor_destructor_codeflags.covers: record flags and the complete TypeFactory decode result/error/partial state

byte_data_ge_0x80.covers: Ghidra std::string can carry arbitrary raw uint1 bytes but Rugra Encoder accepts UTF-8 str; fixture proves the exact ostream behavior only for 0x00..0x10

binary.usage: BfdArchitecture initialization and archid assertion only; no function byte, symbol, or analysis result is consumed

build.snapshot_policy: complete git archive of rugra_base_commit; locked Ghidra C++ subtree archived from oracle commit; only src/cpool.rs overlaid from the leased working tree
build.fixture_policy: both fixture sources are copied to the runner temporary directory and compiled only from those workspace-external copies
build.live_source_exclusions: no live typefactory.rs, datatype.rs, userop.rs, or any other non-owned src file is read or copied
build.cargo_policy: --offline --locked; clean snapshot cpool tests run before the comparand is built
